n8c85cec271.headline: Libya: Liquidity crisis threatens the economy and suffocates citizens - Libya 24 News
n8c85cec271.summary: Libya's banks are facing a severe liquidity crisis despite the central bank's announced injection of 3 billion dinars. Most ATMs have stopped working, making withdrawals difficult for citizens.
n8c85cec271.why: Liquidity shortages at banks disrupt payments and household cash access, and they signal stress in the broader financial system of an oil-exporting economy.

nf6a6c1391d.summary: Australia's government will provide up to A$600 million to Glencore to support retention of its copper smelter, according to a Dow Jones report.
nf6a6c1391d.why: Glencore is a global diversified miner and commodity trader, and copper smelting capacity matters for domestic metal supply and the copper market.
